items.title: Collect a Nuka-Cola Dark
items.detail: Check Eta Psi house basement or buy from Bubbles at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Collect Pre-war Food
items.detail: Use C.A.M.P. devices or loot Sunday Brothers' Cabin basement

items.title: Collect a Microscope or Biometric Scanner
items.detail: West Tek Research Center has several Microscopes in various rooms

items.title: Complete the Event: Mischief Night
items.detail: Public event at Rapidan Camp at the top of the hour

items.title: Kill a Lost during the Mischief Night Event
items.detail: Follow Eyebot JES-2R during the event and kill Lost Dwellers

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Shovel during the Disturbed Grave Quest
items.detail: Equip shovel; low-level enemies like Fireflies at Landview Lighthouse work well

items.title: Visit your Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to C.A.M.P. and enter your Shelter

items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use C.A.M.P. Company Tea generator or find tea elsewhere

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine for reliable spawn

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: Join or create a team, then enter Daily Ops; Phantoms are the masked cultists

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Dino Peaks Mini Golf has 3 reliable spawns; target the belly

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event at Rapidan Camp; Phantom spawns afterward in Vertibot area

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft or scrap Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Scrap Abraxo cleaner, Industrial solvent, Turpentine, or Tick blood sacs

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Whitespring Resort has multiple vendor options

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint and stay under-encumbered; fast travel does not count

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all other daily challenges three separate days during the week

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community contest to build slasher-themed C.A.M.P.s or Shelters with prizes including Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal public event at Rapidan Camp with Pint-Sized Phantom enemies and exclusive rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Weekend event featuring double mutation rates in Daily Operations.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Spooky Scorched enemies with new rewards available.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Weekend event providing double experience points for all activities.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Weekend event with increased chances to catch seasonal fish.
